triggers.desc: Elements side by side, each taking an equal share (flex row, 20px gap).

elements.desc: The child elements (layouts, groups, labels, controls), rendered as direct children of the layout root.

rules.desc: `visible` and `enabled` filtrex rules apply to the whole layout.

class.desc: CSS classes of the root element. When `row`, `column` or `flex` is present, the default flex stacking is not applied, so Quasar grid classes work: `row q-col-gutter-md` on the layout and `col-md-6` on its children.
